correctness.rationale: For n>=3, cubicity gives an exact complement bijection between |N(v)∩D|>=2 for every vertex and open packings of the prism. Its common-neighbor conflict graph equals the square of an auxiliary 2-regular graph with one C_(2n) when n odd and two C_n when n even (including n=3,4). The independent k-sets of C_L^2 correspond bijectively to circular gaps >=3; the marked origin factor L/k yields F_L=1+sum_k (L/k)binom(L-2k-1,k-1)x^k. Complement cardinalities give the complete polynomial and top coefficients derive all six residue optimizer counts. Direct independent enumeration n=3..8 matched total feasible sets (10,25,46,100,211,441), minimum sizes (4,6,7,8,10,12) and optima (3,16,10,9,35,144). Infinite proof is the conflict-graph/cyclic-gap bijection, not these finite data.
residual_risks: Simple cycles n>=3 only, not C2 or general ladder widths; numerical extremum may have antecedents.
